projects.name: Capria - Ghaf Woods
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of Capria, the third phase of the Ghaf Woods master community in Dubai. Capria expands the forest-living concept with the introduction of two premium residential enclaves—The Wellness Community and The Tranquillity Collection—both designed to promote holistic wellbeing and sustainability.

The development integrates biophilic and salutogenic design principles, WELL residential standards, spa-style pools, wellness gardens, retreat zones, and a private residents’ clubhouse. Homes in Capria offer a choice between two refined interior palettes: Radiance, featuring light and airy tones, and Twilight, characterized by warm and bold aesthetics. The Tranquillity Collection emphasizes privacy and a deep connection to nature while maintaining urban connectivity.

Residents can enjoy a wide range of top-tier amenities, including an exercise gym, swimming pools, a running path, and a dedicated Forest Experience Center. The neighborhood also provides direct access to grocery stores and restaurants, while high-end fixtures and features ensure that luxury living is effortlessly blended with outdoor exploration. A nature-inspired façade distinguishes the development within Dubai, offering cutting-edge architecture and unique features unlike any other.

Capria - Ghaf Woods is a greenfield mid rise (4 - 14) project in Dubai, valued at USD 50.0 million, at design. Developed by Majid Al Futtaim Group (Dubai). Lead consultant Ssh Design. No contractor appointed. Completion date not recorded in the source workbook.

Tower A rises to a total of 48 floors, comprising a basement, a ground floor, four parking levels, one health club floor, two mechanical floors, forty residential floors, and a rooftop. Tower B consists of 39 floors, including a basement, a ground floor, four parking levels, and thirty-four residential floors.

 
Nestled amidst lush greenery, the project offers premium apartments that blend modernity and comfort, ensuring residents enjoy an unmatched lifestyle. Strategically located in Jumeirah Village Triangle, the development provides seamless connectivity to Dubai’s most iconic landmarks, including Downtown Dubai, Dubai Marina, and Palm Jumeirah.

The community will offer several dining options, outdoor walkways, and a marina promenade. The 36 luxury villas, designed with a contemporary, low-rise, and low-impact configuration, will offer an integrated waterfront experience with beautiful sea and sunset views.

The new development offers a tranquil lifestyle with a focus on nature and wellness and is surrounded by mangrove forests. The community will feature a 65-berth marina, promenade, and sunset observation point. The signature Yacht Club will have an upscale dining venue, member’s lounge, gym, and terraces with picturesque views of the marina, water channel, and Abu Dhabi skyline. projects.name: The Hamdan Bin Rashid Cancer Charity Hospital
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of The Hamdan Bin Rashid Cancer Charity Hospital. Spanning 56,000 square meters, the seven-storey hospital will be Dubai’s first fully modular-built hospital. The modular concept allows flexibility for future expansion and reduces design time by 50 percent, construction time by 30 percent, and cost by 20 percent.

Situated in the Al Jaddaf area, the hospital is designed to include 50 clinics, 30 clinical research areas, 60 infusion rooms, 10 urgent care rooms, 5 radiotherapy rooms, and 116 inpatient beds. Creating a healing atmosphere, the hospital campus will feature 19 gardens.

The comprehensive cancer hospital will benefit from a multidisciplinary team, including specialized nursing, offering patients a complete range of care services in one location, from early diagnosis to treatment and supportive care.

The Hamdan Bin Rashid Cancer Charity Hospital is a greenfield hospital project in Dubai, valued at USD 204.2 million, at under construction (100.0 percent complete). Developed by Dar Mix (Ajman) (Diyar Ajman General Contracting Llc),Dubai Development Authority (Dda),Al Jalila Foundation,Dubai Health Authority (Dha). Lead consultant Stantec (Dubai),Al Bait International Architectural Design Consultancy. Main contractor Innovo Build Llc; MEP contractor Innovo Build Llc. Completion date not recorded in the source workbook.

projects.name: UTOPIA Urban Resort Villas - DAMAC Hill
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of a villa named 'Utopia,' offering 31 contemporary villas, drawing inspiration from the perpetual pleasures of a resort holiday. Each of these spacious homes features luxurious signature elements such as private infinity pools, home cinemas, in-villa spas, basement entertainment areas, underground parking with a turntable, and more.

The villas, available in three configurations with five to seven bedrooms, have been meticulously designed to optimize natural light, panoramic views of the golf course or lake, and privacy. The clean architectural lines of the villas are complemented by lush indigenous greenery, cool metals, and opulent marble. These select villas boast exceptional views of an internationally acclaimed golf course and private internal lush green courtyards.

Residents of Utopia will not only enjoy the amenities within their homes but also have access to the various offerings in the Damac Hills community. These include Malibu Bay, a wave pool with lively beach-like vibes, the Trump International Golf Club for golf enthusiasts, stables for equestrians, a petting farm and dog park for animal lovers, and facilities for tennis, volleyball, cricket, football, and more for the athletically inclined.

UTOPIA Urban Resort Villas - DAMAC Hill is a greenfield low rise (1 -3) project in Dubai, valued at USD 110.0 million, at tender. Developed by Damac Properties Co. Llc. projects.name: Sobha Central
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of Sobha Central, a landmark mixed-use development by Sobha Realty located on Sheikh Zayed Road in Dubai. Designed as a “vertical urban sanctuary,” the masterplan includes six premium residential towers connected via an elevated circulation path that links residents to a variety of amenities, including a state-of-the-art gym, theatre, clubhouse, and select lift cores with internal access to a luxury shopping mall, restaurants, supermarkets, and a Grand Hall.

Sobha Central will launch with 1,225 residential units in its first tower—The Horizon—offering a curated mix of one- and two-bedroom apartments targeted at modern homeowners and investors. The towers will feature private themed courtyards nestled within a central green park, offering over 250,000 sq. ft. of open space. Sky-level amenities will include landscaped terraces, infinity pools, wellness lounges, and recreational decks.

The development will also include 160,000 sq. ft. of luxury retail space, a car-free shopping and dining podium, and 175,000 sq. ft. of leasable office space. Eco-conscious features such as energy-efficient HVAC systems, EV charging stations, double-glazed façades, and advanced district cooling systems are integrated into the design to ensure long-term sustainability.

Strategically located for excellent connectivity, Sobha Central offers quick access to key areas like JBR, Dubai Marina, Dubai Internet City, and Media City—making it a highly attractive destination for both residents and investors. 

Sobha Central is a greenfield mega urban development project in Dubai, valued at USD 3600.0 million, at design. Developed by Sobha Realty. No consultant recorded. No contractor appointed. Completion date not recorded in the source workbook.

projects.name: Maysan - Phase 1 - Reem Island

The project involves the construction of phase 1 of Maysan development consists of two distinct districts: Mayar and Thoraya. Spanning over 600,000 square meters, the design emphasizes boutique-style living, blending innovation and creativity in both indoor and outdoor spaces. The Mayar district features 132 stacked maisonettes, a new concept for Abu Dhabi, seamlessly integrating the natural environment with modern living. These thoughtfully crafted spaces create a lively community, offering enriching and memorable experiences.

Drawing inspiration from contemporary gallery aesthetics, the maisonettes cater to a variety of needs, from large families looking to live close together, to investors seeking ownership of entire apartment buildings, to individuals desiring resort-style apartment living. Nestled within a secure, gated community, the four-story maisonettes are surrounded by a spacious central park with scenic walking trails.

The Thoraya district embodies contemporary elegance and community spirit. Its 184 architecturally impressive townhouses, built with high-quality materials, create a visually striking landscape. A private entrance ensures both security and exclusivity. Thoraya includes communal gardens, children's play areas, and a gym, providing an ideal mix of relaxation and recreation while embracing nature.

Aiming to attract a broad audience families, professionals, investors, and expats, Maysan will offer curated lifestyle amenities, including a community center, beach access, and park facilities. The development is connected by a walkable green spine, promoting wellness and a healthy lifestyle. 

Future phases of Maysan will include various villas, including park and beach residences. These spacious homes, with efficient layouts and striking facades, will range from three to five bedrooms.

projects.name: Dubai Mangroves
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of a mangrove project in Dubai. Encompassing 72 kilometers of coastline, the project aims to plant over 100 million mangrove trees, positioning it as the world’s largest coastal regeneration endeavor and positioning Dubai as one of the most resilient cities by 2040. Its vast scale and visionary approach mark a significant step towards sustainable urban development, harmonizing the restoration of crucial mangrove ecosystems with the enhancement of urban areas. 

The initiative prioritizes mangroves for their exceptional capacity to sequester carbon, safeguard coastal regions from erosion, and sustain marine life and food security. With mangroves capable of absorbing approximately 12.3 kg of CO2 annually per tree, the entire project could sequester 1.23 million tonnes of CO2 each year, equivalent to eliminating the emissions of over 260,000 gasoline-powered passenger vehicles annually. Central to the project is the recognition of mangroves' indispensable role in preserving coastal ecologies, emphasizing their effectiveness in carbon sequestration, biodiversity support, and natural defense against climate change impacts such as erosion and sea level rise. This dedicated investment in mangroves responds to the urgent call for innovative and sustainable solutions to global environmental challenges, positioning Dubai as a trailblazer in coastal and urban ecosystem preservation.

The project also incorporates various edutainment assets, including the Mangrove Visitor Hub, designed to educate and engage the community and visitors on the significance of mangroves and broader environmental challenges. Together with the Botanical Museum and the Nature Reserve Conservation Center, these facilities will serve as hubs for research, education, and advocacy, fostering environmental stewardship among residents and tourists alike.

Dubai Mangroves stands as a testament to Dubai’s commitment to sustainable urban growth and environmental stewardship. By intertwining ecological conservation with the city’s developmental aspirations, the project not only aims to bolster Dubai’s coastal resilience but also to enrich its green infrastructure. This initiative reflects a profound understanding of the delicate balance between development and nature, underscoring Dubai’s leadership in shaping future cities that prioritize the health of their natural environments. The Dubai Mangroves project aims to establish a global standard, demonstrating that effective coastal regeneration is both essential and achievable for urban centers worldwide, ensuring a resilient and biodiverse future for generations to come.

Dubai Mangroves is a greenfield mega urban development project in Dubai, valued at USD 500.0 million, at concept. The developer is not yet recorded. No consultant recorded. No contractor appointed. Completion date not recorded in the source workbook.

projects.name: SOL Luxe Tower - Trade Centre First

The project involves the construction of Sol Luxe Tower, a landmark mixed-use development located in Trade Centre First on Sheikh Zayed Road, Dubai. Standing 280 metres tall with a configuration of a basement, ground, 59 floors, and a roof, the tower is set to become one of the tallest freehold developments on the boulevard.

The development integrates residential, commercial, and retail spaces in one of the city’s most prestigious corridors. The lower levels will house 66 Grade A office units with 3.7-metre ceiling heights and sweeping views of the Dubai skyline, while the ground floor will feature curated F&B retail outlets with 9-metre-high frontages and direct access to Sheikh Zayed Road. The upper levels are dedicated to 288 premium residences in one-, two-, and three-bedroom configurations with studies, offering uninterrupted views of Burj Khalifa and the sea.

Residents will enjoy a host of luxury amenities such as a swimming pool, kids’ pool, gym, indoor-outdoor fitness areas, kids’ play zones, healthcare facilities, landscaped zones, supermarket, private balconies, and basement parking. Additional wellness and leisure features include a jacuzzi with views of Burj Khalifa and Burj Al Arab, rooftop mini golf, yoga decks, barbecue pavilions, multipurpose halls, terrace lounges, and dedicated spaces for families and children. Commercial tenants will also benefit from dedicated amenities such as private meeting rooms and flexible indoor/outdoor event spaces.

The tower’s bronze-and-glass sculptural façade, with curved glass edges and horizontal bronze bands, reflects Dubai’s modern skyline. Sustainability features include high-performance glazing, solar-control systems, water-saving technologies, and EV-ready infrastructure. AI-powered smart systems will enhance building operations through air-quality optimization, predictive maintenance, and secure visitor management.

The project involves the construction of the UAE’s first dedicated proton therapy centre in Dubai. The Yas Proton Therapy Centre will introduce cutting-edge cancer treatment capabilities to the region through the use of proton therapy, an advanced and highly targeted form of radiation therapy that minimizes damage to surrounding healthy tissues.

This world-class medical facility will cater to both paediatric and complex tumour cases, particularly those located near sensitive organs. Proton therapy is renowned for its precision and reduced side effects compared to conventional radiation therapy, making it especially suitable for younger patients and cancers requiring a high degree of targeting.

The Yas Proton Therapy Centre aligns with national healthcare priorities including the National Strategy for Wellbeing 2031, Dubai Social Agenda 33, and Dubai Economic Agenda D33. It will support the emirate’s ambition to become a top global destination for advanced medical care and innovation, while also contributing to Dubai’s Medical Tourism Vision, which aims to attract over 500,000 international patients annually.

The project involves the construction of a Butterfly Garden in Al Qana. Situated adjacent to The National Aquarium at Al Qana, Butterfly Gardens Abu Dhabi will act as a haven for more than 2,000 butterflies representing over 40 different species, all amidst a stunning collection of plants and wildlife. 

The project encompasses three meticulously designed zones: Asia, the Americas, and Eden Cafe. Visitors will embark on a remarkable journey as they explore lush tropical gardens, each inspired by the distinctive ecosystems found in Asia, Central, and South America.

Beyond the enchanting butterflies and insects native to these regions, the Eden Cafe promises a tranquil retreat with features like a cascading waterfall, a serene koi pond, graceful white peacocks, and even the opportunity to enjoy high tea in the company of butterflies.

At Butterfly Gardens Abu Dhabi, guests will have the extraordinary opportunity to observe butterflies in their natural habitat, freely interacting with visitors. The insect species will be thoughtfully presented in enclosures along the planned route, and pupa displays will offer a firsthand look at the captivating transformation of these creatures.

The gardens are destined to be a paradise for photographers, with plans to introduce photography classes in the future. A unique feature will be the ability to visit the gardens under a starlit night setting, allowing for evening visits.

The indoor facility will feature climate control, ensuring optimal conditions for both the flora and fauna while providing year-round comfort for visitors.

The project involves the construction of Breez by Danube, a 60-storey residential tower positioned as the tallest development in Dubai Maritime City. Designed as a landmark address, the tower will cover a built-up area of approximately 1.5 million sq. ft. and house 1,200 residences. These include modern studios, 1–4 bedroom apartments, and ultra-exclusive duplex villas, each thoughtfully designed to maximize space, functionality, and sweeping views of the Arabian Gulf. All units are delivered fully furnished with elegant interiors, ensuring a move-in ready experience for homeowners.

Breez offers a lifestyle that redefines waterfront living, integrating resort-style amenities with intelligent residential design. Key features include rooftop infinity pools overlooking the ocean, state-of-the-art wellness and fitness centers, landscaped jogging tracks, outdoor cinemas, BBQ decks, lush gardens, and children’s play areas. The grand lobby will be anchored by a 1,500 sq. ft. aquarium and a waterfall atrium inspired by the rhythm of the ocean, blending theatrical architectural gestures with everyday practicality. Complementing the residences, curated retail and dining outlets will add convenience and community vibrancy within the tower.

Strategically located between Port Rashid and Dubai Drydocks, Breez sits within a low-density, maritime-inspired enclave that offers tranquility alongside fast links to Dubai’s major business and leisure hubs. The tower is minutes away from landmarks such as Dubai Frame, the Gold Souk, Jumeirah Beach, and Dubai World Trade Centre, while maintaining easy connectivity to Downtown Dubai, DIFC, and Dubai International Airport. An upcoming metro station and the international cruise terminal will further enhance accessibility.

Set on one of Abu Dhabi’s most prestigious beachfront locations, the residences will feature architecture and interiors that reflect the surrounding natural beauty and coastal environment. Each home is thoughtfully designed to offer a seamless blend of elegance, privacy, and functionality, suited for individuals seeking curated, high-end living.

Additionally, the community will be serviced by a dedicated Four Seasons residential team offering concierge, housekeeping, wellness, culinary, and property management services to deliver a signature service-rich lifestyle.

The project involves the construction of Alta View, a 55-storey residential tower and a basement level located in Jumeirah Village Circle, Dubai. The project will comprise an estimated 499 residential units in a mix of studios, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartments, designed with spacious layouts, smart systems, and contemporary finishes. Floor-to-ceiling windows, ergonomic configurations, and open-concept interiors ensure a natural flow of space and light throughout the living areas.

Alta View is envisioned as one of the tallest residential buildings in JVC and incorporates eco-friendly architectural elements, promoting a lifestyle that blends sophistication with nature. The development prioritizes wellness and community living, offering expansive terraces, panoramic views, and nature-inspired features that reflect a modern, intentional way of life.

Residents will benefit from resort-style amenities, including a lagoon-style swimming pool, water slide, Aqua & Sand oasis, children’s pool, indoor and outdoor play areas, fitness facilities (including a gym, tennis courts, CrossFit zone, and table tennis area), clubhouse, BBQ zones, and lush landscaped gardens. Retail outlets on the ground floor will provide convenience for daily needs.

One of the defining features of the project is the Sky Infinity Terrace—a premium rooftop observation and leisure deck offering 360-degree views of the JVC skyline and surrounding green spaces. Complementing this are additional rooftop amenities such as the Sky Leisure Deck, Sky Infinity Pool, and sunken lounge zones, creating a sanctuary above the city for rest and recreation.

The Residences will provide an elegant lifestyle within a lively and dynamic community, combining waterfront living with timeless architecture. The project involves the construction of Selene Beach Residences by Sobha Group, a luxury residential development located on the pristine Siniya Island in Umm Al Quwain. This exclusive project offers a selection of 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, as well as 3-bedroom duplex apartments with a total of 546 units, all featuring modern architecture and breathtaking views of the Arabian Gulf and lush golf courses. Nestled in a natural paradise, the development provides a serene escape while being seamlessly connected to the mainland via a 1.7 km bridge, ensuring convenient access to key regions and attractions.

Residents of Selene Beach Residences will enjoy a wide range of world-class amenities designed to elevate their living experience. The development also features direct access to pristine beaches, a lagoon, and a variety of water sports activities, creating a perfect blend of relaxation and adventure.

The luxurious island lifestyle at Selene Beach Residences is complemented by additional amenities such as outdoor gyms, kids' play areas, retail outlets, jogging trails, BBQ areas, and expansive parks and gardens. The community is also home to an 18-hole championship golf course, exclusive yacht club, and helipad, catering to residents seeking both tranquility and excitement. With its combination of natural beauty and luxury living, Selene Beach Residences offers a unique and unparalleled coastal experience in Umm Al Quwain. projects.name: Ajwan Khorfakkan Residences

The project offers high-end living inspired by nature, located on the water's edge and featuring the first-of-its-kind waterpark in the eastern region. It aims to create a thriving environment for families, communities, commerce, and tourism in a charming coastal town.

Spread across a reclaimed plot of 65,269 sqm, the project integrates luxurious housing and impressive facilities, including a Waterpark with thrilling slides and water sports, swimming pools, access to the beach, and public amenities. The development consists of 6 residential buildings, comprising 184 residences ranging from 2 to 4 bedrooms, including duplex options. The units have a saleable area ranging from 124 sqm to 417 sqm.

The unique landscape-style architecture features terraces on each level, offering panoramic views to residents above a state-of-the-art podium and retail space. The design takes inspiration from the coastal conditions, incorporating the fluidity and forms of the landform and sea.

The podium level provides various amenities and activities suitable for all ages, including lap and kids pools, creating an appealing living space with captivating water views.  The ground floors of the complex are dedicated to commercial spaces, offering necessary amenities for project owners while remaining easily accessible to residents. The gated community is conveniently located near Khorfakkan beach, just a 5-minute drive from the iconic amphitheater and waterfalls of the town. Ajwan Khorfakkan Residences is a greenfield mega urban development project in Sharjah, valued at USD 400.0 million, at tender. Developed by Sharjah Investment & Development Authority (Shurooq). The project involves the construction of Seamont Autograph Collection Residences by Marriott, a premium residential complex situated in the coastal Shams district of Al Reem Island, Abu Dhabi. Designed to offer a resort-inspired lifestyle, the architecture features soft lines, natural stone finishes, warm wooden textures, and panoramic glazing. Over 80% of the residences provide direct sea views, with seamless access to the promenade from the first floor. Select podium-level residences include private terrace gardens, while units on higher levels offer uninterrupted vistas of the surrounding waterfront.

The residential units range in size from 731 to 6,233 square feet and come partially furnished. Residents benefit from 43,000+ square feet of five-star amenities, including an infinity pool, children’s pool, spa with sauna and steam rooms, yoga and cardio studios, a fully equipped gym, indoor cinema, business lounge, library, BBQ areas, outdoor seating zones, and dedicated children's play areas. Villa Aria covers approximately 45,000 sq ft with two interior styles: Ultra, featuring opulent contemporary design, and Terra, with earthy, extravagant finishes; each villa includes saunas, spa pools, lounges, entertainment systems, and recreational outdoor spaces.

Villa Amorino, adheres to Vastu principles, offering a plot of 32,630 square feet, living area of 12,690 square feet, and five bedrooms. This villa also provides two design environment options: 'Terra' and 'Ultra'

projects.name: Azha Millennium Residences

The project involves the construction of Azha Millennium Residences, a 34-storey ultra-luxury branded mixed-use tower. The development will feature 196 branded apartments under the Millennium Hotels & Resorts brand, alongside curated retail outlets at the podium level.

The residential units are thoughtfully distributed across 56 studios, 84 one-bedroom, and 56 two-bedroom apartments. Studio units start from 375 square feet, one-bedroom units span up to 979 square feet, and two-bedroom units reach up to 1,746 square feet. 

Designed for modern, sustainable urban living, Azha Millennium Residences will integrate futuristic architecture and smart-living features. Amenities include a rooftop health club, swimming pool with panoramic JVT views, indoor cinema, lounge, entertainment room, and hotel-style services such as 24/7 concierge, valet parking, housekeeping, and in-room dining. The podium levels will house over 300 parking spaces and community facilities like a BBQ area, garden, children’s play areas, and a café lounge.

projects.name: Bugatti Residences by Binghatti - Business Bay
projects.description:
The project will involve the construction of the world's first Bugatti Residences in Business Bay. The 46-floor tower will include 171 Riviera Mansions, and 11 Sky Mansion penthouses aiming to bring the exclusive Bugatti lifestyle to life.  Each unit in the Bugatti Residences by Binghatti offers stunning views of the Dubai Water Canal and the Burj Khalifa Downtown. The project features two-, three-, and four-bedroom penthouses, each named after iconic destinations like Cannes, St Tropez, and Monaco. Inspired by the French Riviera and Dubai's dunes, the residences boast exterior contours resembling ripples. the units will range from 185 sqm to 4,087 sqm.

The first Bugatti residence will include a beach inspired by the Riviera, a private pool, a jacuzzi spa, a fitness club, a chef's table, private valet service, a members club, and two car lifts from the garage to the penthouse. Each unit will have its dedicated parking space, and the highest penthouse will accommodate up to 20 parking slots. Additionally, one floor will serve as an exhibition space for special cars owned by residents.

Inspired by Bugatti's French heritage and expert craftsmanship, the residences will embody the tranquil ambience of the French Riviera. Each residence is designed to perfection, featuring luxury furniture, appliances, and fittings from renowned brands such as Gessi, Flos, Minotti, B&B, Aromas, Lutron, Miele, and Gaggenau. The development promises a luxurious lifestyle with a myriad of 5-star amenities, including fitness centers, an immersive cinema room, Le Petit Residents Area, and a Resident’s Lounge.

Additionally, residents will enjoy a selection of exclusive luxury services tailored to enhance their living experience. Core services include a residence concierge, 24/7 security, and doormen, while a la carte offerings range from in-residence maintenance and private transportation services to dry cleaning, dog walking, on-site childcare, and personal shopping services. Developed by Beyond, part of the Omniyat Group, the towers feature layered balconies, bronze-tinted façades, and uninterrupted views of the Arabian Gulf, The Cove, The Forest, and Downtown Dubai.

Soulever offers a diverse residential mix of 513 units, including one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, two-bedroom podium chalets with private pools, four-bedroom duplexes with splash pools and marina views, and five-bedroom penthouses with roof gardens and outdoor kitchens. Designed with 3.2-metre ceiling heights, open-plan layouts, and panoramic terraces, each residence blends luxury with functionality.

The towers are oriented to maximize sea, skyline, and sunset views, while the façades of brass and glass reflect architectural elegance. Residents enjoy resort-inspired amenities such as landscaped podium gardens and terraces, pools and spa facilities, a waterfront gym club, library spaces, and family areas.

 

Soulever is positioned in a freehold community with strategic connectivity to Downtown Dubai, DIFC, Jumeirah, and Dubai International Airport, offering both a lifestyle upgrade and a compelling investment opportunity.

The project will have a 360-degree view of three museums on the island. Louvre Residences enjoys connectivity to the renowned Louvre Museum in Abu Dhabi, as well as the neighboring Guggenheim Abu Dhabi and Zayed National Museum. The project proudly boasts the esteemed Estidama Pearl 2 rating and LEED Silver Certification.

projects.name: Vertical City
projects.description:
The project involves the development of a sustainable Vertical City-building with 100,000 people settled in the water. The building incorporates renewable energy resources and energy storage solutions, water desalination, and food production/farming with a zero-waste policy. The building has green areas, natural light and ventilation, 100% green transport systems, and is based on a modular, prefabricated structure with photovoltaic glass for energy independence. The design aims to promote a healthier lifestyle and rethink the traditional concept of community and society.

The city building is a vertical structure with 180 floors, 750 meters in height. It has a green area of 200,000 square meters, including a public garden at the top, and incorporates farming, social space, and self-sufficiency. The structure consists of 10 modular layers, each with 18 floors, housing apartments, duplexes, and villas, as well as offices, stores, and other facilities. The building is energy-independent and has a green transport system. The structure is designed for natural light and air circulation and includes community spaces for water baths, markets, spiritual, and cultural hubs.

The Vertical City can be reached by water, land, or air. It has an equipped circular basement with external and internal docks and three naval entries, including external berths for large boats and internal navigation for smaller boats. The mainland is connected via a semi-submersed bridge for pedestrians and electric transport, and the tower has heliports connected to the upper garden square and vertical linking installations. Vertical City is a greenfield mega urban development project in Dubai, valued at USD 200.0 million, at concept. The developer is not yet recorded. No consultant recorded. No contractor appointed. Completion date not recorded in the source workbook.

The Canaletto walnut essence infuses depth and warmth into the furnishings, while the seating is adorned with opulent, tactile fabric coverings. projects.name: Ellington Belgrove Residences - Mohammed Bin Rashid City (MBR)

The project involves the construction of a residential building in Mohammed Bin Rashid City. This development will feature a ground floor, four podium levels, 26 residential floors, and a rooftop. It offers a range of meticulously designed 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, each tailored to deliver an exceptional living experience. The building’s elegant design, inspired by the gracefulness of flamingos, embodies a commitment to beauty, balance, and innovation.

The residence boasts amenities designed to enhance the lifestyle of its occupants. The entrance sets a welcoming tone, featuring a drop-off area and a lobby arcade that extends into a lobby with lounges, a reception area, a communal table, swings, and a library wall. Additional features include a rooftop observatory and an outdoor cinema, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere.

The serene zone caters to family activities, with options for outdoor dining, flamingo-themed lounges, and picnic areas. The adults' zone offers a relaxing pool deck with sunken seating, while the kids' zone provides dedicated pools and play areas. A special pets zone is also available, complete with play and wash areas for pets.

Located in the heart of Mohammed Bin Rashid City (MBR City), the residence offers breathtaking views of the Dubai skyline and the Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary. Its prime location ensures easy access to major landmarks: Burj Al Arab is just 22 minutes away, while Burj Khalifa and Dubai Mall are each a mere 10 minutes from the property. Dubai International Airport is a quick 9-minute drive, and the Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC) is reachable in 18 minutes. Palm Jumeirah is 28 minutes away, and the Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary is just 6 minutes from the residence.

projects.name: Floating Healthcare Island
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of a Floating Healthcare Island in Dubai. The core skyscraper is divided into two parts: the base, spanning 670,000 square meters, which accommodates educational activities, and the crescent, covering 330,000 square meters, dedicated to functions such as the exhibition hall, research and development department, science and technology park, library, and exhibition of digital achievements.

Following the core skyscraper, there will be 14 towers with medical functions, likely serving as medical facilities or hospitals. These towers will contribute to the island's infrastructure and provide healthcare services.

Furthermore, 24 hotels will be located on the two ends of the island, symmetrically framing the core skyscraper. These hotels will likely cater to visitors and tourists, offering accommodation and hospitality services.

To enhance the island's aesthetics and environmental sustainability, Kalbod Studio plans to line all the structures with terraces and rooftops featuring a variety of vegetation. This greenery will not only provide shade but also help with natural ventilation and contribute to improving Dubai's air quality. The integration of vegetation in the design is a sustainable approach that aligns with the growing trend of incorporating green spaces into urban environments.

The development boasts a remarkable array of amenities, including a welcoming lobby with a lounge, a clubhouse, a co-working zone with a library, an arcade room, and the Harmonic Hall. Residents can enjoy wellness facilities like a fitness studio, yoga studio, and chromotherapy steam and sauna rooms. For families, there are dedicated indoor and outdoor play areas for children. The property also features a leisure pool, a lap pool, a shaded kids' pool, and a barbecue deck with outdoor dining options, creating the perfect balance between relaxation and entertainment.

Nestled in a strategic location, this project sits adjacent to Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, offering easy access to essential hubs for a thriving life in one of the fastest-growing and safest communities. projects.name: Bab Al Qasr Canal View Residence 22
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of Bab Al Qasr Canal View Residence 22, a premium hotel-branded residential development located along the canal waterfront in Al Raha Beach, Abu Dhabi. Developed by Burtville Developments, the project features three architecturally distinct residential towers designed to maximize natural light and panoramic views of the canal and sea.

Comprising 242 fully furnished units, the residence includes a mix of simplex apartments, duplexes, and exclusive sky villas. Each home is equipped with high-quality interior finishes such as warm wooden flooring, built-in wardrobes, marble accents, and modern appliances. The development emphasizes comfort and convenience through hotel-style services, including optional housekeeping, valet parking, and in-residence dining.

Residents will have access to a suite of lifestyle amenities such as rooftop infinity pools atop each tower, two additional ground-level pools, landscaped green areas, and six retail outlets on the ground floor offering a supermarket, pharmacy, salons, pastry shop, café, and a casual restaurant.

As part of the Bab Al Qasr hospitality partnership, each unit includes five years of complimentary access to Yas Beach Club for up to six people and similar access to the beach and pool facilities at Bab Al Qasr Hotel in Abu Dhabi. Strategically located near Yas Island, Zayed International Airport, and downtown Abu Dhabi, the development is positioned to attract both residents and investors seeking an upscale, well-connected living experience.

projects.name: Sobha Elwood - Dubai Land
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of Sobha Elwood, a visionary residential development located within DubaiLand, Dubai, embodying the concept of The Canvas of Nature. This premium community is designed around the harmony of nature, offering a sanctuary of tranquility amidst over 416,000 square meters of open spaces and parks. Key amenities include an amphitheater, communal gardens, a clubhouse, a basketball court, jogging tracks, and more. With over 10,000 trees and seven themed parks inspired by the world’s largest forests, the development promises an enhanced lifestyle in a lush, green environment. The community also includes essential amenities like a clinic, an on-site school, and EV charging solutions, promoting eco-conscious living.

Sobha Elwood offers 167 luxury 4, 5, and 6-bedroom villas, each thoughtfully crafted with expansive spaces, large windows, and earthy tones to blend seamlessly with the natural surroundings. The villas are modern interpretations of contemporary living, featuring open-plan layouts that prioritize functionality and a deep connection to nature. In addition to the serene residential experience, residents will enjoy exclusive access to two clubhouses, a community shopping center, and an array of sports and fitness facilities. The community is designed to promote wellness, with dedicated jogging and cycling tracks, skate parks, padel tennis courts, and therapeutic wellness areas.

Strategically located in Dubailand, Sobha Elwood offers quick access to major highways, ensuring seamless connectivity to Downtown Dubai, Dubai Marina, and Dubai International Airport. The development promises an unmatched living experience where luxury and nature converge, providing a rejuvenating environment with fresh air, lush greenery, and a wide range of recreational facilities. From the lap pool and splash pads to adventure trails and forest paths, this urban oasis invites residents to immerse themselves in the tranquility of The Canvas of Nature while enjoying all the conveniences of modern life.

Sobha Elwood - Dubai Land is a greenfield low rise (1 -3) project in Dubai, valued at USD 500.0 million, at under construction (100.0 percent complete). Developed by Dubai Holding,Sobha Realty. Lead consultant Pnc Architects; MEP consultant Pnc Architects. Main contractor Sobha Constructions Llc (Sobha Hartland Contracting); MEP contractor Sobha Constructions Llc (Sobha Hartland Contracting). Completion date not recorded in the source workbook.

The project involves the construction of SOL Levante, a 27-storey mixed-use development in Jumeirah Village Triangle (JVT), Dubai. The development features 612 meticulously designed residential units, including studios, one-bedroom, one-bedroom with study, and two-bedroom with study apartments. Additionally, it includes 100,000 sq. ft. of office space and 50,000 sq. ft. of retail area, creating a comprehensive destination for residents and businesses.

Designed with a U-shaped structure, the development maximizes natural light and seamlessly integrates indoor and outdoor living. It is strategically positioned with easy access to Al Khail Road and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, ensuring connectivity to key destinations such as Dubai Marina, Bluewaters Island, and major shopping malls. Residents will benefit from proximity to international schools, healthcare facilities, and community parks.

The development’s podium, spanning 50,000 sq. ft., is designed to enhance community living with a range of wellness and recreational amenities. These include an infinity-edge swimming pool, jacuzzi, indoor and outdoor gym, outdoor cinema, mini golf, multipurpose court, padel tennis, pet park, BBQ areas, sunken garden, kids' playground, jogging track, co-working spaces, and event spaces. These facilities aim to foster a balanced and connected lifestyle for residents.

SOL Levante is positioned to be a landmark destination within Jumeirah Village Triangle, combining architectural elegance, contemporary design, and world-class amenities to redefine modern urban living in Dubai.
